# Verifier persona: expected values must be present in the sheet.

[CHECK]
check_id = V-1

what_to_look_at = amount column
expected_value_or_rule = must equal 100
when_it_fails_say = expected amount 100 not present
machine_can_check = yes
column_name = amount
example_that_passes = a row with amount 100
example_that_fails = a row with amount 0
